entities.name: Combined tracking area updating procedure
entities.description: Procedure for combined tracking area and location area updating, which may include TMSI reallocation.

entities.name: TRACKING AREA UPDATE ACCEPT
entities.description: Message sent by network to accept tracking area update request, may contain LAI, TMSI, and update result IEs.

entities.name: TRACKING AREA UPDATE COMPLETE
entities.description: Message sent by UE to confirm TMSI reallocation during combined tracking area updating.

entities.name: Additional update result IE
entities.description: Information element indicating update result values like 'SMS only' or 'CS Fallback not preferred'.

entities.name: Additional update type IE
entities.description: Information element used by UE to request specific update types like 'SMS only'.

entities.name: EPS update result IE
entities.description: Information element indicating EPS update results, including ISR activation status.

entities.name: TMSI
entities.description: Temporary Mobile Subscriber Identity allocated during TMSI reallocation procedure.

entities.name: Location Area Identification
entities.description: Location Area Identification included in TRACKING AREA UPDATE ACCEPT message.

entities.name: T3450
entities.description: Timer started by MME during TMSI reallocation part of combined tracking area updating.

entities.name: EMM-COMMON-PROCEDURE-INITIATED
entities.description: EMM state entered by MME when TMSI reallocation is part of combined tracking area updating.

entities.name: EMM-REGISTERED
entities.description: EMM state entered by network after receiving TRACKING AREA UPDATE COMPLETE message.

entities.name: SMS only requested condition
entities.description: Condition when UE requests 'SMS only' in Additional update type IE.

entities.name: MME stores LAI
entities.description: MME behavior to store location area identification from TRACKING AREA UPDATE ACCEPT message.

relations.description: Combined tracking area updating procedure includes sending TRACKING AREA UPDATE ACCEPT message.
TRACKING AREA UPDATE ACCEPT message contains Location Area Identification.
TRACKING AREA UPDATE ACCEPT message may contain TMSI during reallocation.
TRACKING AREA UPDATE ACCEPT message contains Additional update result IE.
TRACKING AREA UPDATE ACCEPT message may contain EPS update result IE.
Combined tracking area updating with TMSI reallocation requires MME to enter EMM-COMMON-PROCEDURE-INITIATED state.
MME starts timer T3450 during TMSI reallocation part of combined tracking area updating.
Network stops timer T3450 upon receiving TRACKING AREA UPDATE COMPLETE message.
Receiving TRACKING AREA UPDATE COMPLETE message causes network to change to EMM-REGISTERED state.
When UE requests 'SMS only', network indicates 'SMS only' in Additional update result IE.
UE stores received LAI from TRACKING AREA UPDATE ACCEPT message.
